{{Top|leg}}
The '''Outer Rim Restaurant and Lounge''' was a restaurant located on Level A on one of the wings of [[Spaceport THX1138]]. Its motto was "We can provide meal and drinks for all kinds of being." Meals and drinks included on its menu were the [[Hive Cantina]], [[Kri'gee/Legends|Mandalorian Kri'gee]], [[Garrmorl]], the [[Twin Suns Special]], [[Ithorian brandy]], the [[Keela (meal)|Keela]], and [[Polar water]].
